name: Logic Lab
desc: A boolean-logic lab: seven gates plus half and full adders, with live signal levels, truth tables and carry readouts.
controls: A/B/C input toggles, eight presets (AND/OR/XOR/NAND/NOR/XNOR/half adder/full adder); keys A, B, C toggle inputs, keys 1–8 load presets
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
